sources.prompt: EDIT TARGET: the supplied approved planet concept sheet. Production background-extraction only. Preserve the EXACT eight painted planet designs, their colors, surface architecture, details, silhouettes and 4 columns by 2 rows order. Remove ALL navy background AND ALL caption lettering completely and replace with genuine alpha transparency. No text anywhere. Eight whole isolated globes on transparent canvas, equal cells with at least 5% margin, no overlap. Crisp natural planet edges, absolutely NO blue ring, NO atmospheric halo. Do not invent new planet designs, do not flatten into vector. Increase native detail/resolution if possible, preferably 3072x2048. Preserve the approved hand-painted artwork. Output RGBA transparent sprite atlas.

Edit the supplied APPROVED five-planet concept sheet, background-extraction ONLY. Keep the exact five complete painted globes and all their surface designs, colors, ink outlines, proportions and details. Remove ALL navy backdrop and ALL text captions; replace every outside pixel with real alpha transparency. Absolutely no blue ring, no atmospheric glow, no cyan border. Rearrange as clean transparent atlas of THREE columns TWO rows, first row jungle/volcanic/colony, second row industrial at left and ruins in middle, last cell empty. Each globe fully within its own equal cell with 8% margin, no overlap, no labels. Preserve approved subjects, no redesign. RGBA transparent output, preferably 3072x2048.
